I teach mathematics and quantitative methods at the Faculty of Management, AGH University of
Krakow, mostly to students who will use these tools rather than prove theorems with them. My
aim in every course is that a method arrives together with the question it answers.

## For students

I am happy to supervise or co-supervise theses that use Input–Output methods, environmental
accounting or applied statistics on Polish data. If you have an idea in that area, write to me
with a paragraph describing it.
